title: Junior Python Developer
description:

- write database migrations and keep queries fast
- cover new code with automated tests
- take part in code reviews and help improve our CI pipeline

What we expect:
- You have up to 2 years of commercial experience, or strong personal projects.
- You know Python well and have used FastAPI at least in a project of your own.
- You understand how HTTP and relational databases work.
- You have worked with PostgreSQL and Docker, or are keen to learn them quickly.

Nice to have: basic knowledge of cloud services and interest in the hospitality domain.

We offer an employment contract (umowa o pracę) with paid holidays, English lessons, a Multisport card and a budget for your home office. You will work from our office near the Wrocław old town, with 2 days a week from home.

Recruitment has three steps: a short call with our recruiter, a technical conversation with the team (no live-coding puzzles), and a final meeting with the team lead.
